inputs.text: This is another case of government reaching for an easy target instead of confronting people who turn guns into illegal machine guns. Her 2026 State of the State agenda would make gunmakers share responsibility for weapons sold in New York, while adding criminal penalties without even saying who would face them. That kind of vagueness invites officials to widen the burden from manufacturers to people who obey the law. Public safety matters, but punishing an entire industry won’t restore order or hold the actual lawbreakers accountable.
